policy: Every waiver needs requirement_id, risk, rationale, compensating_control, owner, approval, created, expires. High/critical waivers must expire within 90 days. An expired unresolved waiver fails the production gate. Non-expiring high-risk waivers are prohibited.

entries.description: Pure-Python capability checks are not a hostile-code boundary; adversarial workloads would need namespaces/seccomp/Wasm/microVM.
entries.rationale: No such runtime is in scope for this repository.
entries.compensating_control: Production profile forbids adversarial in-process workloads (docs/OPERATIONS.md §Isolation); isolation.run_isolated for semi-trusted code; profile_status() reports adversarial_production_ready=false.

entries.compensating_control: Manifest marks signature UNAPPROVED_DEV; release gate refuses GO.
